async def act(page):
    # Fill in product name
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[STORE VIEW] Product Name *").fill("FancyBoy Man Causal Jeans")
    # Fill in SKU (required field, generate a simple one)
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[GLOBAL] SKU *").fill("FANCYBOY-JEANS-001")
    # Fill in price
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[GLOBAL] Price * $").fill("169.99")
    # Fill in quantity
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[GLOBAL] Quantity").fill("42")
    # Set tax class to default 'Taxable Goods' (already selected per tree)
    # Set stock status to default 'In Stock' (already selected)
    # Set weight to default 'This item has weight' (already selected)
    # Set visibility to default 'Catalog, Search' (already selected)
    # Set country of manufacture to default (first option selected)
    # Try to find and set size attribute
    size_locator = page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("size", exact=False))
    if await size_locator.count() > 0:
        await size_locator.select_option("34")
    else:
        # If not found, log or skip
        pass
    # Try to find and set color attribute
    color_locator = page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("color", exact=False))
    if await color_locator.count() > 0:
        await color_locator.select_option("Blue")
    else:
        pass
    # Click Save button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
